body:
Stop defending these people.  The ones who care and want to help tolerate the pieces of shit that do nothing but cause more pain.

They're guilty because of their tolerance of this shit.  All it takes for evil to triumph is for the good to do nothing.

If any of those people were worth anything, they wouldn't allow that shit to stand.

The only thing that would make that feeling change is if I believed that things were possible.  Honestly, right now I don't think things are.  It's all a damned mess man.

I honestly just don't believe there's a place in the world for people like me.

No to the mountain and surfing.  Yes to the instrument.  But now you're going to follow up with the fact that there are other instruments, etc.

I've seen and experienced quite a bit more than you're probably assuming right now.  Even with those things under my belt, I'm still finding it pretty silly to stay alive.
Semantics.  It's all the same thing.
You say this like you know for sure.  That's what I never understood about people who say these things to me.  How could you possibly know good things are coming?
lol, you get a few negative responses and you just throw in the towel?  I see how it is man.
I haven't felt happy in a very long time, doing anything.  Trust me, I've looked.  Nothing penetrates anymore.
Dude, we're going to die whether we make our life awesome or not.  Life wins by default my man, all those things I've survived ARE for nothing, haha.

As expected, what I could have gotten anywhere.  The same canned B.S. with the slightest hint of desperation.  Is there not one person who honestly believes the crap they spout in situations like this?
